concept: The Silent Kitchen: a 3:12 original family-comedy storyboard, NOT a finished motion film

shots.title: The quiet challenge
shots.action: Maya faces camera with a microphone. Ethan carries breakfast in the back.
shots.dialogue: Maya: Just three quiet minutes. I need one clean recording.

shots.title: Ethan's promise
shots.action: Ethan raises two fingers, pledging silence, while the family dog watches.
shots.dialogue: Ethan: I can make breakfast without one single sound.

shots.title: The first beep
shots.action: Ethan taps an unfamiliar silent-mode button on a kitchen tablet.

shots.title: Suspicious calm
shots.action: A toaster door opens without a click. Ethan bows proudly to Maya.
shots.dialogue: Maya: Maybe you really did it.

shots.title: Unexpected subtitles
shots.action: A giant on-screen caption pops up for every kitchen motion: SPOON, BOWL, SPOON.
shots.dialogue: Ethan: It muted sounds, not the notifications?

shots.title: Dog notices first
shots.action: Dog's ears turn toward the tablet, which keeps displaying captions.
shots.dialogue: Maya: Why is it writing down our breakfast?

shots.title: The cereal weather report
shots.action: A robot announces it has detected a 'cereal storm'; cereal scatters across the table.

shots.title: Ethan doubles down
shots.action: Ethan waves away the alert and tries to close the smart curtain.

shots.title: Curtain rebellion
shots.action: The curtain instead opens; sunlight hits a stack of silver pans.
shots.dialogue: Maya: That's the opposite of quiet.

shots.title: Chain reaction
shots.action: A camera tripod bumps a pan; the dog moves it with its nose, setting off more alerts.
shots.dialogue: Device: Movement detected in the kitchen.

shots.title: Maya's unspoken look
shots.action: Maya slowly turns to Ethan. Ethan freezes holding the empty cereal box.
shots.dialogue: Ethan: Before you say anything, I have a plan.

shots.title: The simple solution
shots.action: Dog sits beside the tablet, covering the touch sensor with a paw.
shots.dialogue: Maya: Wait. The dog knows how to stop it?

shots.title: Silence at last
shots.action: All the smart device alerts disappear. The two exchange a relieved look.
shots.dialogue: Maya: That is the smartest one in this house.

shots.title: One perfect sentence
shots.action: Maya starts recording at last while Ethan holds his breath.
shots.dialogue: Maya: Good morning, and welcome to my—

shots.title: The real punchline
shots.action: The dog taps an icon labelled APPLAUSE. The screen erupts with giant cheering captions.
shots.dialogue: Ethan: We never taught it that.

shots.title: Next episode hook
shots.action: Dog examines the setting 'AUTOMATE BEDTIME'. Maya and Ethan exchange worried looks.
shots.dialogue: Maya and Ethan: Don't press that.
